query: [bright] SELECT TOP 10000 g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.radial_velocity, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, g.ref_epoch, g.ruwe, g.l, g.b, ap.teff_gspphot, ap.lum_flame FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters AS ap ON g.source_id = ap.source_id WHERE g.parallax > 0 AND g.parallax_over_error > 10 AND g.ruwe < 1.4 ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC || [nearby] SELECT TOP 25000 g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.radial_velocity, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, g.ref_epoch, g.ruwe, g.l, g.b, ap.teff_gspphot, ap.lum_flame FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters AS ap ON g.source_id = ap.source_id WHERE g.parallax > 0 AND g.parallax_over_error > 10 AND g.ruwe < 1.4 AND g.parallax > 10 ORDER BY parallax DESC || [field] SELECT TOP 15000 g.source_id, g.ra, g.dec, g.parallax, g.parallax_error, g.pmra, g.pmdec, g.radial_velocity, g.phot_g_mean_mag, g.bp_rp, g.ref_epoch, g.ruwe, g.l, g.b, ap.teff_gspphot, ap.lum_flame FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS g LEFT OUTER JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters AS ap ON g.source_id = ap.source_id WHERE g.parallax > 0 AND g.parallax_over_error > 10 AND g.ruwe < 1.4 AND g.parallax BETWEEN 0.25 AND 1.0 AND g.phot_g_mean_mag < 13 AND g.random_index < 150000000
attribution: ESA/Gaia/DPAC; Gaia Collaboration, Vallenari et al. 2023
coverage: 49192 unique sources (21438 with FLAME luminosity); bright/nearby/field selection — not a galaxy census
units: deg, mas, mas/yr, km/s, mag, K, L_sun, pc
frame: ICRS, epoch J2016.0; cartesian pc with Sun at origin; galactic l,b from Gaia
note: Served from the ARI Heidelberg Gaia mirror (ESA archive timed out). Distances = 1000/parallax only for parallax_over_error > 10; uncertainties retained.
